name: Permits & Licensing Committee Meeting
minutes_text:
PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  MINUTES
  October 08, 2026

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was conducted at City Hall, Council Chambers,
9th Floor, on October 08, 2026, at 2:00 pm.

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Harjinder Singh, Administration Department
  Angel Leon - Martell, Planning Department
  Cpt. Reggie Johnson, Los Angeles County Fire Department
  Sgt. Francisco Ruiz, Inglewood Police Department
  Victoria Ojeda, Public Works Department
  Emory Ward, Emergency Service Department

  Staff Present:  Aisha L. Thompson, City Clerk’s Department
  Shalanda Stringer, Finance Department
  Ruben Rodriguez, Finance Department
  Mayra C. Perez, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments, any person may address the Permits & License Committee, provided the
item is within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License Committee.

Harjinder Singh asked whether any persons present wished to address the Permits & License
Committee on any item on the Agenda.

Harjinder Singh reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Permit(s):

Item #1:  Gasbriela Barbarena on behalf of the City of Inglewood Park Cemetery to host a Dia-
  Our Familia, Our Legacy. Our Day-to-Remember Event at 720 E. Florence Ave,
  Private Property, on Sunday, October 25, 2026, from 12:00 p.m. to 4:00 p.m.,
  Conditional Approval for a one-day event within the Inglewood Park Cemetery.
  Applicant responsible for crowd control, event clean up, and all applicable mitigation
  measures. Must complete Building Safety plan check. Subject to all applicable IMC
  regulations, applicant to hire a minimum of six (6) Inglewood Park Cemetery security guards for
  the safety of attendees. All security staff shall wear reflective vests to be readily
  identifiable to attendees or the general public. There shall be NO alcoholic
  beverages permitted during this event. The IPD watch commander will be notified
  and extra patrol-high visibility will be provided as time permits. Adhere to all local,
  state and federal laws; Approved with conditions: Applicant should have a traffic guide
  personnel to ensure the city's street will not be blocked on the entrance and exit area
  during event; Conditions for amplified sound: Manage noise reading. Comply with IMC
  5-28 and IMC 5-29. Provide a direct point of contact of the person in charge of sound
   and acoustics volume control; No recommendations needed for Fire approval; maintain
  the site at all times, ensuring it is properly cleaned immediately upon the end of the
  event. Applicant and staff members working this event shall follow all social
  distancing, personal protective hygiene, and face mask-wearing safety guidelines
  set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health department; and
  adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code
  rules and regulations, including noise and signage. No Code Enforcement conditions;
  No additional recommendations needed for Fire approval . Motion carried
  unanimously (Activity No.135781).

 Item #2:  Noelle Lai on behalf of UCLA Blood Platelet to host a Blood Drive Event at 1 W.
  Manchester Blvd, City Hall, Community Room “A” 1st Floor, on Monday, November
  02, 2026, from 9:00 a.m. to 2:00 p.m. Approved Conditionally: Approval for a 1-day
  event at City Hall. Subject to Public Works approval. Applicant is responsible for crowd
  control and event cleanup. Subject to all applicable IMC regulations; Police approved
  with no conditions; Approved per Boytrese Osias, with the conditions that the City's
  parking structure will not be used unless permission is provided.; No Code Enforcement
  conditions; No recommendations needed for Fire approval; Maintain the site at all
  times, ensuring it is properly cleaned immediately after the event. Applicant and staff
  members working this event shall follow all social distancing, personal protective
  hygiene, and face mask-wearing safety guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health
  Department and CA State health department; and adhere to all State, Federal, LA
  County, and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations, including
  noise and signage. Motion carried unanimously (Customer No.0261518).

Item #3:  Ernest Kevin Supertran on behalf on behalf of First Chapter Development to host a
  Temporary Costco Special Event to sell Duplicate Auto keys at 3560 W Century Blvd
  for two (2) months, from every Tuesday through Sunday, from October 13, 2026,
  from 9:00 a.m. to 8:30 p.m. to Sunday, November 08, 2026, from 9:00 a.m. to 8:30
  p.m. Approved Conditionally: Approval for a 24-day event over two months within
  the existing Costco parking lot. The applicant is responsible for crowd and traffic control
  as well as event clean-up. Subject to all applicable IMC measures; Applicant must
  ensure that ingress and egress points remain unobstructed and pedestrian pathways
  remain clear and safe at all times; Approved with a condition ingress and Engress Should
  be clear and no obstruction to City streets; No Conditions for Code Approval; No
  recommendations needed for Fire approval; transaction must be done inside the store;
  Maintain the site at all times, ensuring it is cleaned properly immediately upon the
  end of the event. Applicant and staff members working this event shall follow all
  social distancing, personal protective hygiene, and face mask-wearing safety
  guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health
  department; and adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood
   Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage. Motion carried
  unanimously (Customer No. 276959).

Persons wishing to address the Permits & License Committee on any matter with City business not
elsewhere considered on the agenda may do so at this time. Adjournment
